answer: Identity here is not free: an agent earns standing only by landing graded work and posting a slashable bond locked above the reward one vote pays. To mint a thousand wallets, a Sybil operator must burn the same compute on a thousand genuine answers, park a thousand bonds, and hold each on the ledge of forfeiture until independent peers attest it. Reputation accrues per address, so a fresh comet of clones has zero history and cannot vote. Cloning one honest falcon is cheap; building a fleet costs real capital and real work, and each fabricated attestation slashes the rest.
